text: I've really enjoyed my coaching sessions with Shimmer. My friends and family have noticed I've been managing my ADHD a lot better since starting with coach Tracy. The AI session summary is great to keep track of what was discussed in each session so you have a journal of sorts of things you are working towards.
author: Freya L.
developer_reply: We’re so happy to hear that coaching with Shimmer, especially your work with coach Tracy, has been such a positive and meaningful experience for you. It’s wonderful that both you and the people around you are noticing the progress you’ve been making with managing your ADHD. We’ll be sure to pass your kind words along to Tracy as well. 💛

text: Shimmer is absolutely amazing and truly life-changing. I've been nothing but impressed and grateful. You should be aware that it's not so much an app as an entire program designed around helping ADHD'ers to live their best lives. My coach is beyond-words-fantastic, and I also love the regular group events like monthly and quarterly planning. The whole thing is so effective and so helpful, run by people who really understand.
author: Christine Brinker
developer_reply: Thank you so much for your kind words! We’re thrilled to hear Shimmer and your coach have made such a positive impact, and we’re grateful to have you in our community!

text: good app, very optimal. has financal support as well

text: Great app, love the reminders ahead of sessions and the chat abilities. also, the issues I had before were addressed beautifully. Old review: App takes forever to load. Well, it takes a full 20 seconds each time, which isn't terrible usable when you're trying to respond to a message or log something. Google Pixel 5. Then within the app, things get extremely hung up at times. See also "Please wait 5 to 10 seconds" searching on for eternity.

text: Had my first coaching call & it was excellent. Prepped by answering questions on frustrations & goals. Coach provided me with two new strategies to try this week. Looking forward to our next chat!
author: Arian Dineen
developer_reply: Love hearing this! We're so glad your first session felt supportive and actionable. 🎉 Huge kudos to you for showing up and diving in—excited for all that’s ahead on your journey! 💛

text: You must have a USA mobile number to sign up, so this app is only for America
author: Zoe Barrett
developer_reply: Hi Zoe, thanks for your interest in trying Shimmer! We don't require a US mobile number to sign up — you can sign up with any international phone number as Shimmer is open to members globally! Please contact us at support@shimmer.care if you are running into any difficulties during the signup process and we'd be happy to help :)

text: Signed up about a month ago. My coach adapted to my style and what I needed from her, which is really special because I am a rebel. I like to do things my way and change plans often. The 15 minutes a week are up to the point and very useful. My coach also meaningfully checks in every few days with nudges and encouragements. The body doubling sessions are interesting, but I need to fit them in my schedule... A task for another day. Very happy with the service Shimmer offers.
author: Ileana B
developer_reply: This made our day—thank you for sharing! 💛 We love that your coach is meeting you where you are (rebel spirit and all!) and that the support feels meaningful. And hey, body doubling will be there whenever you’re ready. So glad Shimmer’s been a helpful part of your journey!

text: Accountability and ACT- two extremely effective tools to manage ADHD. Subscription plans starting at over$100/month for non-clinical weekly check in service . Overall solid, science driven support program but price point is unrealistic and inaccessible.
author: Phoenix Counseling
developer_reply: Really appreciate your thoughtful feedback—we’re so glad the science-backed approach resonated. 💛 We hear you on the price point and are actively working on making Shimmer more accessible. If you’d like, reach out at support@shimmer.care—we’d love to explore options with you.

text: exceptional experience
author: Andy Palmer
developer_reply: So glad to hear you’re having an exceptional experience—that means the world to us! 💛 We’re here with you every step of the way.

text: I got nothing from it, just a guy half listening and asking if I've tried Meetup for friends. He wanted me to start writing again and never asked why I stopped, which was really important and something I wouldn't share immediately. I expected strategies, tools, etc. I got basically the therapy stereotype of a person writing on a note pad and going, " huh." He was late both times and after pushing that I should message out of session if needed, didn't even seem to have read anything I said.
author: Midnight Weary
developer_reply: We’re really sorry to hear this—it’s not the experience we want anyone to have. Your trust and time matter deeply, and we clearly missed the mark. If you're open to it, please reach out to support@shimmer.care—we’d truly appreciate the chance to make things right. 💛

text: Thieves. Attempted to steal my money without providing anything dropping the ball with the professionals missing THEIR appointments. text: My coach Tory absolutely changed the way I think about life. Every time I talked to her I felt like my ADHD made just a little more sense. She kept me on track and held me accountable for all the habits and changes I wanted to make. I paid for this service for about 6 months and that was really all I needed. For some people, medication may be the answer. But since ADHD meds have never helped me, behavioral therapy was the way to go. I HIGHLY recommend this service to those who can afford it.
author: Hailyn Bryant
developer_reply: Thank you so much for sharing this—it’s incredible to hear how impactful your time with Tory was. 💛 We're honored to have been part of your journey, and so glad behavioral support made a real difference. Wishing you continued momentum and clarity ahead!

text: I absolutely love my coach and the whole Shinmer program. I've only been doing it for 2 months and already my life is better organized and less stressful, my productive time is more productive and my free time is more freeing, and I feel like I have more, better tools to course correct without getting caught up in a negative feedback loop. Even my relationships are better! Love that the app has integrated tasks. And, push notifications work consistently and show up on my smartwatch! Yay
